title: Topic 9
japanese_text:
A：やっぱり部長、秘書と<u>不倫して</u>たらしいよ。先月のパーティで<u>親密な</u>関係になったんだって。
B：ええ！ 偉そうなことを言いながら不倫だなんて<u>軽蔑し</u>ちゃうな。秘書を<u>いやらしい</u>目で見てたんじゃないかと思うと吐き気がするよ。奥さんとは離婚だろうね。
A：それは分からないよ。<u>当人</u>同士が決めることだからね。
english_translation: A: I knew it. I heard the boss was having an affair with his secretary. They got intimate at the party last month. B: What?! I despise the fact that he is having an affair while acting so arrogantly. It makes me nauseous to think he's been ogling his secretary in a lecherous way. He and his wife will probably get divorced. A: I don't know about that. That's for those involved to work out.
